how_this_grows: bottom-up, from statements. A term enters the vocabulary when a claim needs it. The taxonomy's subpoints are a suggestion pool to search before inventing a near-duplicate, and join the vocabulary the moment a statement uses one.

vocabulary.label: Capability profiling
vocabulary.note: Inferring a per-ability profile rather than a single score, so that future performance can be predicted per scenario.

vocabulary.label: Dissociative agent identity
vocabulary.note: An LLM agent is an assemblage of swappable modules, so the persistent identity reputation presumes may not exist. 5.3 covers reputation systems and 6.1 covers identity issuance; neither names the case where identity fails to persist at all.

vocabulary.label: Dynamic evaluation
vocabulary.note: Evaluation whose test distribution depends on the policy being evaluated. The proposed answer to endogenous non-stationarity, and what 2606.03237 argues no current suite achieves.

vocabulary.label: Endogenous non-stationarity
vocabulary.note: Deployment changes the environment the system was evaluated against, because other actors respond. Distinct from ordinary distribution shift: the system's own action is the cause.

vocabulary.label: Ex ante behavioral harness
vocabulary.note: Constraining and monitoring an agent in real time, rather than rating and punishing it afterwards. The alternative 2605.30169 proposes once it argues reputation is structurally inapplicable — and the distinction its whole argument turns on, which nothing in the pool named.

vocabulary.label: Organizational knowledge legibility
vocabulary.note: Making an organization's routines, rules and tacit know-how machine-readable so they can be governed. The core construct of the Artificial Organizational Intelligence work.

vocabulary.label: Prosocial capability
vocabulary.note: Cooperation, reciprocity and restraint measured as a capability in its own right, separately from task score. The distinction 2509.14485 shows a leaderboard collapses.

vocabulary.label: Sanction sensitivity
vocabulary.note: Whether a principal can be made worse off by a penalty. A precondition for every ex post governance mechanism, and the thing that is missing when the agent is cheap to replace.

vocabulary.label: Shared schemas for agentic organization data
Stake-based trust
vocabulary.note: Trust backed by something forfeitable. Sits alongside the reputation systems already at 5.3 and is the mechanism 2511.03434 recommends in their place for high-impact actions.

vocabulary.label: Train-test-deploy gap
vocabulary.note: The third term is the new one. Held-out test data still comes from the pre-deployment world.
